description: Asked whether the house would come down, and dusted round the letter without opening it.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Took threepence, refused another man's lease as kitchen business, and stopped the lost wife at the door of the plot.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Sat at the table when damp was mentioned, and did not speak.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Reported a damp post, two mornings, and no price, and kept the letter as it was.
name: William Shakespeare
